card.description:
**Job Description** 
We are seeking a highly strategic and technically accomplished EW Operations Engineering Director with strong Hardware, Systems, and RF design experience, to bridge the gap between advance systems development and factory production. This executive-level role requires a deeply experienced leader who understands product requirements and performance to oversee the complete Life Cycle Management (LCM) of complex hardware ensuring that highly sophisticated Digital and RF Designs seamlessly transition from design environments into full scale production.
 
The ideal candidate possesses deep domain expertise in Electronic Warfare (EW) systems and acts as the ultimate authority and liaison between Systems/Hardware Designs engineering and Manufacturing Operations. You will champion “Left Shift” engineering philosophies-refining, shaping, and validating hardware configurations long before they reach the factory floor to optimize, yield, efficiency, and electrical and mechanical compliances
 
•**Key Responsibilities**
 
•**Strategic Operations and Factory Leadership**
 
•Production Lifecycle Management: Own the end-to-end process governing how critical hardware is moved, staged, and executes across factories of record.
 
•Factory of record integration: Maintain comprehensive understanding of the People, Build, Equipment limitations, Operational Rules and technical boundaries to align design tolerances with factory capabilities.
 
•Operational Compliance: Author, Develop, and Maintain the Manufacturing Design Rules Documents in collaboration with the process engineers and subject matter experts (SME). Establish robust mitigation strategies for Non-compliant or ‘Red” technical requirements
 
•Technology Insertion: Evaluate, introduce, and integrate new manufacturing and test technologies and evolving factory capabilities to continually improve product lines.
 
•**Cross-Functional Engineering Liaison & Governance**
 
•Design-to-Production: Acts as the strategic liaison between Systems/HW Design and Operations “Enforcing” high standard and quality for manufacturing readiness and knowing precisely when to push back on design elements that challenge manufacturability
 
•Change Control & Audits : Represent Operations by attending and activity presenting Manufacturability requirements at the Engineering Leadership CARBs (Change/Configuration Action review Boards)
 
•Compliance & Technical Reviews: Demonstrate, Organize and Execute Systems/HW programs reviews including CCB (Change Control Boards) and PRB (Program Review Boards) to mitigate electrical compliance
 
•Left Shift & Process Optimization: Drive early-Stage engagement through the P2L/NPI processes to shape, refine and mature hardware layouts prior to factory entry
 
•**Test Engineering Strategy and Operations Engagement**
 
•Production test architecture: Oversee and understand the vision and long-term production test strategy, ensuring test development frameworks are fully integrated with operations,
 
•Design-for-Test (DFT): Partner directly with Hardware Design and test development engineering to enforce strict Production Test requirements and enforcing the Operations Test Rules 
 
 
 
**Required Education, Experience, & Skills** 

•**Required Qualifications and Experience:**

•Education: Bachelors or Masters Degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Operations or a closely related technical discipline

•Experience Level: Minimum of 20+ years of dedicated System/HW designs and Engineering/Operational Leadership with complex digital and high-frequency RF hardware domain

•Domain Expertise: Technical proficiency of electronic warfare (EW) systems. Including an expert-level understanding of how the hardware behaves internally and externally under operating conditions. Understanding critical System Tradeoffs in electrical performance.

•LCM Mastery: Documented success reshaping the Life-Cycle Management (LCM) paradigms, establishing “Left-Shift” framework and streamlining product handoffs to manufacturing

•Governance: Extensive background running rigorous technical reviews, electrical compliance boards, CCBs and PRBs

 
 
**Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills** 

•**Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement**

•Cross Discipline Mobilization: Lead, Mentor and rally multi-discipline, cross-functional engineering and operational teams to achieve swift pragmatic solutions (Driving to high confidence \*80% rule)

Trend Analysis & Optimizations: Partner with the program engineering groups to monitor production trends, identify anomalies, isolate hardware failure modes, and making data driven discissions )
 
 
**Pay Information**
 
Full-Time Salary Range: $173023 - $294137
 
 
Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
 
 
Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. 
 
 
 
**About BAE Systems, Inc.**
 
BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support.
 
 
Our culture is performance-driven and values-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. We're developing breakthrough technologies that defend national security and make a lasting impact on our communities and our planet. When you join BAE Systems, you're not just building a career. You're contributing to a mission that truly matters.
 
 
This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

card.description:
Job Overview
 
The Sr. Director, Customer Experience & Quality owns the enterprise-wide direction and execution of Vontier Convenience Retails’ global strategy for customer experience, product quality, and reliability. The role serves as the senior advocate for the customer, this leader establishes global standards, governance, and priorities across global functions. Translating customer feedback, field performance, warranty data, and quality insights into priorities that improve products, services, processes, and support. This leader provides oversight and direction for improving the customer experience and connects Design for Reliability, Supplier Quality Management, Manufacturing Process Control, field quality, and Customer Service & Support into an integrated end-to-end customer experience. Working closely with commercial, product, engineering, procurement, manufacturing, service, and regional leaders, this position drives rapid issue resolution, systemic corrective action, and continuous improvement across the full product life cycle to increase customer satisfaction, loyalty, and business performance.
 
Responsibilities
 

* Own, create, and execute the enterprise-wide global customer experience and quality strategy, setting direction, priorities, and standards, and measurable objectives that advance business objectives, strengthens customer loyalty, and continuously improves customer outcomes.
* Establish and govern a disciplined enterprise voice-of-customer process that integrates customer feedback, complaints, service data, warranty trends, and field performance into product and operational priorities.
* Own and direct the global customer issue management and escalation process, ensuring rapid containment, transparent communication, root-cause resolution, and verification of corrective-action effectiveness.
* Build trusted relationships with strategic customers and customer quality teams; represent the business in quality reviews, escalations, and long-range improvement planning, with accountability for commitments and customer outcomes
* Implement and further develop the Vontier Reliability System to improve product reliability, serviceability, and customer experience across the installed base.
* Develop and lead a multi-year enterprise deployment plan aligned to the customer experience and quality strategy, including performance targets, resources, processes, governance, and organizational capability.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Commercial, Service, Procurement, and Manufacturing to embed customer requirements and quality controls from concept through end of life.
* Develop, govern, and continuously improve an integrated enterprise performance system covering customer satisfaction, complaint responsiveness, repeat issues, field reliability, warranty, external PPM, first-pass yield, and cost of poor quality.

card.description:
***Please Note:*** *To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.*

At **CesiumAstro**, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add an experienced **Senior Staff Quality Engineer** to our team. In this position, you will serve as a trusted quality engineering resource, advancing product and process quality through quality planning, process validation, and continuous improvement initiatives. This role strengthens manufacturing and operational performance by evaluating quality systems, improving process capability, and implementing quality strategies that ensure products consistently meet customer, regulatory, and organizational requirements.

Working cross-functionally with quality, engineering, operations, manufacturing, supply chain, and program management, this role supports quality assurance, process improvement, product validation, and manufacturing activities while ensuring products and processes comply with quality standards, customer requirements, and business objectives.

### **JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead quality assurance activities by evaluating product and process requirements, quality system performance, inspection results, and manufacturing processes to ensure compliance with established standards.
* Develop quality strategies that improve product quality, process capability, manufacturing consistency, and customer satisfaction while supporting operational objectives.
* Evaluate quality risks, manufacturing performance, and process variation while implementing corrective actions and preventive measures that strengthen product and process quality.
* Maintain quality records, inspection documentation, nonconformance reports, and quality data within quality management systems to support compliance, traceability, and reporting.
* Develop quality metrics, process capability analyses, inspection summaries, trend reports, and operational dashboards that support business decisions and quality improvement initiatives.
* Evaluate quality trends, audit findings, process performance, and corrective action effectiveness to identify opportunities that improve quality system performance and operational excellence.
* Partner cross-functionally with quality, engineering, operations, manufacturing, supply chain, program management, and finance to align quality objectives with operational priorities and customer requirements.
* Communicate quality risks, inspection findings, process concerns, quality trends, and improvement recommendations to stakeholders to support informed operational decision-making.
* Coordinate quality activities that support manufacturing readiness, product acceptance, customer requirements, new product introductions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Drive implementation of quality process improvements and operational initiatives that improve product quality, manufacturing performance, and process consistency.
* Develop quality procedures, inspection methodologies, audit practices, and operational standards that strengthen quality system effectiveness and organizational consistency.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of quality assurance processes, manufacturing operations, and overall organizational performance.

### **JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field with 12–15 years of related experience, or a Master's degree with 8–12 years of related experience in quality assurance, quality engineering, manufacturing, operations, or a related discipline.
* Advanced knowledge of quality assurance, quality engineering, manufacturing quality, and process improvement principles.
* Expertise in quality management systems, inspection methodologies, product verification, process control techniques, quality planning, and risk-based quality management.
* Experience applying quality procedures, inspection documentation, nonconformance reporting, corrective and preventive action (CAPA), audit processes, and quality reporting methodologies.
* Knowledge of quality standards, root cause analysis methodologies, statistical process control (SPC), measurement systems analysis (MSA), process capability analysis, and continuous improvement principles.
* Familiarity with internal auditing practices, manufacturing quality requirements, regulatory compliance expectations, and quality system governance.
* Ability to evaluate quality trends, identify operational risks, and implement practical quality solutions that improve product quality, process capability, and manufacturing performance.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate inspection results, process capability, manufacturing performance, and quality system effectiveness.
* Demonstrates sound judgment when balancing quality requirements, manufacturing priorities, customer expectations, regulatory requirements, and operational objectives.
* Experiecne with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, e.g. Oracle, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite, or equivalent applications.
* Expertise in quality management systems (QMS), e.g. ETQ Reliance, Arena QMS, MasterControl, or equivalent applications.

### **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* Manufacturing experience in the aerospace or electronics industry.
* Six Sigma Black Belt / Green Belt Certified.
* AS9100 / ISO 9000 Auditor.

CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Full-time employment offers include company stock options and a generous benefits package including health, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, disability and retirement plans.

CesiumAstro is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

*Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

card.description:
Cambridge, MA

Development – Quality Assurance /

Full-Time /

Hybrid

 

*Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need.*

*As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at* ***ScholarRock.com*** *and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.*

 

**Summary of Position:**

Scholar Rock is seeking an experienced, hands-on Director, Quality Systems & Digital Quality. Reporting to the Sr Director, Global Quality Systems & Compliance, this leader is an integral part of Scholar Rock’s Quality Management System (QMS) and the GxP computerized systems and data that support it, across our commercial and early-phase pipeline. Because Scholar Rock outsources all GMP manufacturing, testing, and distribution to qualified contract organizations, this role will build and sustain a lean, risk-based, phase-appropriate QMS that meets US (FDA), EU (EMA/EU GMP), and Japan (MHLW/PMDA) requirements, ensuring that Scholar Rock’s own systems are inspection-ready and that the GxP data generated on our behalf by contract partners is reliable, complete, and traceable.

### **Position Responsibilities**

***Quality Management System***

* Partner with Quality process owners to ensure GxP digital systems effectively support QMS processes, enabling efficient, compliant, and scalable operations aligned with Scholar Rock’s evolving business needs.
* Track a focused set of key QMS performance indicators and present them in periodic quality management reviews.

 

***Digital Systems & Computer Software Assurance***

* Provide Quality oversight of Scholar Rock’s GxP computerized systems (largely cloud/SaaS, e.g., eQMS, document and training management, ERP and other GxP-relevant platforms), ensuring compliance with 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, and Japan’s ER/ES guideline.
* Lead and execute GxP system enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives, partnering with business process owners to define requirements, evaluate solutions, manage implementation, and ensure effective adoption of new functionality.
* Establish and apply a risk-based computerized system validation and assurance approach consistent with applicable GxP regulatory requirements, leveraging GAMP 5 principles, relevant FDA guidance, and vendor documentation to ensure appropriate assurance while minimizing redundant testing.
* Oversee the GxP computerized system lifecycle, including risk-based validation and assurance, change control, periodic reviews, access management, audit trail controls, data retention, and system retirement. Ensure appropriate validation deliverables, testing, and documented evidence are established and maintained throughout the system lifecycle.
* Partner with IT and business owners on system selection, implementation, upgrades, and vendor releases so that new digital capabilities are adopted with right-sized assurance.
* Support qualification of computerized system suppliers (e.g., SaaS, software, and IT service providers), including risk-based vendor assessments and audits, and the Part 11/Annex 11 and data integrity provisions of their quality agreements; qualification of GMP manufacturing and testing suppliers remains with other Quality functions.
* Monitor evolving expectations, including the revision of EU GMP Annex 11 and emerging guidance on AI in GxP settings, and advise on practical, compliant adoption of digital and AI-enabled tools.
* Support the implementation of AI-enabled tools in GxP processes (e.g., document drafting and review, deviation and complaint trending, AI features within eQMS and other platforms), defining risk-based assurance, human oversight, and data integrity controls proportionate to each tool’s intended use and impact on product quality and patient safety.
* Partner with IT, Legal, and business owners to establish lightweight governance for AI use in GxP activities, including an inventory of AI applications, acceptable-use expectations, training, and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Lead the development and execution of a risk-based digital Quality roadmap, prioritizing system enhancements and improvements based on business needs, compliance requirements, and operational efficiencies.
* Partner with Quality process owners and cross-functional stakeholders to identify improvement opportunities, translate business needs into functional requirements, and implement scalable digital solutions.
* Drive the end-to-end implementation of GxP system enhancements, including requirements definition, risk assessments, configuration, testing, validation documentation, deployment, and post-implementation support.
* Establish efficient processes for managing system changes, including vendor releases, impact assessments, regression testing, and maintaining systems in a validated state.
* Provide hands-on leadership and technical guidance for Veeva eQMS, eDMS, and other GxP platforms, ensuring effective system functionality, integration, and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear system ownership, governance, and accountability across Quality, IT, and business functions, including responsibilities for system administration, validation, user access, and ongoing lifecycle management.
* Support regulatory inspections and audits involving computerized systems, electronic records, electronic signatures, and data integrity, including preparation of supporting documentation and remediation of identified gaps.
* Drive effective adoption of new digital capabilities through stakeholder engagement, training, change management, and ongoing evaluation of system effectiveness.
* Establish and maintain effective governance for GxP system enhancements and vendor releases, including change prioritization, impact assessments, testing strategies, implementation planning, and post-deployment monitoring.

 

***Data Integrity & Data Governance***

* Lead the development and ongoing governance of Scholar Rock’s GxP data integrity program, establishing risk-based expectations, controls, and oversight mechanisms in partnership with business process owners and applicable Quality functions.
* Define a lightweight data governance model with clear data ownership and stewardship for GxP data across Quality, Regulatory, Technical Operations, and Clinical.
* Extend data integrity oversight to contract organizations through quality agreement requirements, data integrity–focused audit criteria, and review of partner-generated data (e.g., batch records, CoAs, stability, deviations).
* Establish governance and controls for GxP-relevant master data, partnering with designated data owners to ensure data accuracy, consistency, integrity, and appropriate alignment across internal systems, contract partners, and regulatory information.
* Lead data integrity risk assessments and drive timely, proportionate remediation of gaps.

 

***Inspection Readiness & Regulatory Support***

* Lead inspection readiness for the QMS, computerized systems, and data integrity controls, and support health authority inspections of Scholar Rock and its contract partners.
* Contribute to regulatory submissions and responses, such as annual reports, IND/CTA updates, and marketing applications in the US, EU, and Japan.
* Maintain awareness of regulatory changes in the US, EU, and Japan and translate them into practical, minimal-necessary updates to the QMS.

 

***Leadership & Partnership***

* Act as the subject matter expert and coach for colleagues across Quality and partner functions on QMS, computerized system, and data integrity topics.
* Collaborate with the Head of Global Quality and Quality leadership, IT, Regulatory, Technical Operations, and Clinical to align quality systems with corporate goals and regulatory obligations.
* Champion a culture of quality, accountability, and data integrity, and serve as a change agent for simplification and digitization of the QMS.

### **Candidate Requirements**

* BS/MS degree in a scientific, engineering, or information systems discipline.
* 12+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry, with 5+ years leading Quality systems, computerized system compliance, or related programs; biologics experience preferred.
* Deep understanding of GxP and Quality System requirements (US, EU, and Japan) for biologics development and commercial products, including ICH Q9(R1) and Q10.
* Demonstrated expertise in 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, risk-based CSA/GAMP 5, and global data integrity expectations, including qualification of computerized system and SaaS suppliers.
* Familiarity with AI/ML-enabled tools in regulated environments and with emerging health authority expectations for AI use in GxP activities.
* Experience in a virtual or outsourced model, including oversight of quality systems and data integrity at CDMOs and contract testing laboratories.
* Experience leading or supporting regulatory inspections and interfacing with global health authorities.
* Proven ability to design lean, simple processes and to make pragmatic, risk-based decisions on what is required versus nice to have.
* Highly proactive, decisive, and capable of independently managing key initiatives as a hands-on individual contributor.
* Collaborative leader who builds quality culture and capability across teams through influence, coaching, and knowledge sharing.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to influence across functions and with external partners.

$200,000 - $260,000 a year

*Scholar Rock is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees*.
